research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ROLI is focused on enhancing touch-sensitive user interfaces for music technology applications. Their research includes a force sensor system that involves a substrate with resilient protrusions, enabling precise input force measurement. This innovation aims to improve the tactile response and sensitivity of musical devices, potentially offering musicians a more nuanced and expressive way to interact with hardware and software instruments.

overview_description.description: ROLI is a music technology firm. Their products include hardware, software, sounds, and accessories. They make the process of learning and practicing music possible. Their team of musicians, programmers, teachers, anthropologists, engineers, and artists is reimagining music learning and music creation through hardware and software. They design, develop, and manufacture music-making devices.

about_short_description.short_description: ROLI is a music technology company that offers hardware, software, sound solutions, and field accessories.

product.name: ROLI Piano
product.description: A four-octave digital piano with full-size illuminated keys, designed for piano learning, practice, and music creation.

product.name: ROLI Learn app Membership
product.description: A subscription-based piano-learning service offering guided songs, video lessons, practice activities, and games for use with ROLI instruments.

product.name: Airwave
product.description: A hand-tracking device that uses ROLI Vision AI to capture hand position and gestures for piano feedback, musical control, and sound manipulation.

product.name: AI Music Coach
product.description: An AI-assisted music-learning service that provides personalized guidance, practice support, and feedback for piano learners.

product.name: Piano M
product.description: A compact MPE-enabled digital piano controller for expressive performance, music production, and piano learning.

product.name: Seaboard 2
product.description: An MPE-enabled expressive keyboard controller with a continuous surface for per-note pitch, dynamics, and sound-shaping control.
